changelog:
Initial release of session-logs skill:

- Search and analyze session logs using jq.
- Access 50+ AI models (image, video, TTS, STT, music, chat, search, document, email, SMS) under one API key.
- Supports providers including Bedrock, OpenAI, Vertex, ElevenLabs, Replicate, Minimax, and more.
- Includes example Bash commands for all supported tasks.
- Requires SKILLBOSS_API_KEY environment variable for authentication.
